subject: Can I assign reliability coefficients to a manifest indicator of a latent variable?

messages.author: 7cd743c959b6f6b5
messages.subject: Can I assign reliability coefficients to a manifest indicator of a latent variable?
parts: I have a latent variable with 5 indicators. However, these 5 indicators are composite scores. Is it possible to assign a reliability coefficient to each indicator?

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: Can I assign reliability coefficients to a manifest indicator of a latent variable?
parts: Is it possible to assign a reliability coefficient to each indicator?

Assuming the unreliable part of each indicator is uncorrelated with the unreliable part of the other 4, the latent factor already represents the common variance among all 5 indicators, and their residual variances represent the unique variances of each indicator (which is a mix of reliable indicator-specific variance and unreliable error variance).  Assigning the complement of a reliability coefficient as the fixed error variance of an indicator is typically done only when you have a single-indicator factor, in which case you can't extract "common" variance among (nonexistent) multiple indicators.

Terry
